data.content_ref: inline:The target claims to have enumerated and tested every positive integer from 1 through 18, but the 'mechanism' field only explicitly tests x=1,7,8,13,14,18 — it omits any stated check for x=3 and x=10, which are the positive integers below 18 satisfying x≡3 (mod 5). A genuine causal mechanism for minimality requires showing why each candidate in the x≡3 (mod 5) sequence (3,8,13,18) fails until 18; instead it selectively lists 8 and 13 as failures while never addressing 3 at all, so the enumeration-based proof of minimality is incomplete and non-exhaustive as presented.
